text:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-gpu-pool-3 usage 98% (autoscaler failing to add nodes) — queue growth detected for /v1/generate, p95 rising. Paging oncall: @ben_oncall :rotating_light:
ben_oncall: on it. seeing a spike in incoming requests from a few API keys. queue depth jumped to 9k in the last 3m. p95 ~ 3.2s -> 12.8s, p99 ~ 8s -> 48s. timeouts and some 504s reported.
maria_support: getting multiple customer reports — org:acme-inc showing lots of 504s and timeouts around 12:15 UTC. CS wants statement for impacted customers.
priya_platform: looking at autoscaler logs — provisioner request to cloud provider errored with 429 rate_limit on instance create at 12:12:17. backoff retried 3 times then gave up.
lin_infra: confirmed. cloud-side quota throttle for GPU-type (g4dn-like) in eu-west1. autoscaler didn't gracefully fall back to thin-provision pool.
sam_eng: stack traces show the eviction path ran partially — we started evicting idle slots but some worker groups hit a deadlock on lease renewals. partial eviction cascade: some hosts marked draining but new hosts never provisioned.
ben_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) reduce admission by quickly enabling per-key rate-limits for high-traffic keys (CS to identify), 2) enable model-variant fallback to smaller quantized model for low-tier keys, 3) manual emergency scale to dedicated thin-provision pool if cloud quota clears.
priya_platform: applying a temporary 30% global admission throttle at gateway (rolling config). patch: `gateway.rate_limit.temp_throttle=0.7` going out now.
leo_sre: increasing prefix/KV cache TTL to reduce token regen for chat sessions — pushing TTL bump for top routes.
ben_oncall: @maria_support can you get the list of top 10 org ids causing steering traffic? CS needs it to message customers about mitigations.
maria_support: forwarding list now — acme-inc, retailco, analytics-labs, beta-agent, travelapp, two internal test orgs. sending to #customer-status and tagging CS.
cs_bot: Draft status update: "We are investigating elevated timeouts and transient errors on text generation. Our engineers are implementing temporary rate-limits and fallbacks; we'll update within 30 minutes." Approve? :thumbsup:
maria_support: approved, send.
priya_platform: autoscaler logs attach: `ProvisionerRequest(id=xx, status=RATE_LIMIT, retry_count=3)`; we hit cloud creation throttles. Opening support case with cloud now.
lin_infra: manual path: we can flip routing policy to prefer dedicated thin-provision pool in us-east for non-EU orgs. Doing that for low-latency customers and internal test orgs only.
sam_eng: preparing a streaming short-circuit: temporarily disable chunked streaming for /v1/generate for known noisy keys to reduce connection overhead. will push config in 60s.
ben_oncall: rolling mitigation actions in this order: 1) gateway throttle (done), 2) per-key fallbacks (in-progress), 3) streaming short-circuit (in-progress), 4) manual route-swap to thin pool (starting), 5) cloud support case / quota increase request.
incident-bot: NOTE: paging escalation rule triggered: if queue not < 2k in 20m escalate to infra lead @lin_infra and PMG.
priya_platform: cloud support response ETA ~ 45m for quota increase. requesting emergency capacity from partner region and setting cross-region fallback flag for compatible model variants.
leo_sre: after short-circuit push — observed immediate drop in per-connection CPU; queue handled ~15% more concurrent streams. p95 improved to ~8s in 4m.
ben_oncall: good. keep monitoring. @sam_eng can you add a temporary metrics dashboard tile for affected keys and route? also capture number of 504s per org.
sam_eng: added dashboard and alert: `alerts.hosted.queue.spike_recovery` firing at 6942013200 — notifying this channel.
ben_oncall: handoff note for next oncall at 13:00 UTC: if queue >3k and autoscaler still failing, move to mitigation tier B (full admission-limited mode — accept only paid-tier keys and throttle free tier). leaving runbook changes in ops-docs.
maria_support: CS update 12:42 UTC: customers with errors being contacted: acme-inc prioritized. prepping templated email.
lin_infra: manual route-swap to thin pool completed for subset of traffic (non-EU) at 12:46 UTC. observed reduced 504s for those orgs.
ben_oncall: can we avoid eviction thrash once cloud quota resolves? we should disable automatic drain+evict while autoscaler is unhealthy to prevent partial cascades. filed infra issue: `autoscaler:pause-evict-on-provisioner-error`.
priya_platform: created cloud support case 987654 — waiting. also increasing autoscaler backoff to avoid tight retry loops.
leo_sre: overall numbers at 12:55 UTC: queue depth 1.9k, p95 6.1s, p99 22s, 504s trending down. still some customer hits but mitigations showing effect.
ben_oncall: marking this incident as partial-mitigation. next steps: follow up on cloud quota, implement autoscaler safety (pause eviction), and prepare a postmortem. handoff to @lin_infra for follow-up.
lin_infra: taking follow-up. will add root-cause timeline and link to postmortem doc. tagging @sam_eng and @priya_platform for fix items.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: degraded -> stabilizing. Keep channel for follow-ups and postmortem notes.
ben_oncall: thanks team. logging pager oncall details and closing active paging loop. if anyone sees a regression re-ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
